title: pages.table_changed v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the pages module when a table's properties, views or set of rows change (a row added, put in the trash, brought back or deleted for good), so a view that is open asks for the table again; the change feed announces it to the members who may open the table. A cell edit is announced as pages.page_changed of its row, kind `values`. Ids and enums only, never a property name, an option, a view name or any value. `revision` grows with every change of one table: apply only newer ones. Workspace-scoped; also listed in openapi/events.json.

kinds.description: What changed: the properties or options (`schema`), the views, or the set of rows.
